verdict: Paid media is dark; GBP activity dropped sharply and needs immediate attention.
narrative: No paid ads ran on Meta or Google this period, meaning zero paid leads were generated over the last 28 days. Your Google Business Profile carried all the organic load — 159 actions including 54 calls and 105 website clicks — but in the last 7 days that activity collapsed 87% versus the prior week, with the last 4 days showing no recorded actions at all. Meanwhile, organic search and site sessions remain active, which means people are looking for you but have no paid path to reach you and your local listing may not be surfacing as it should. The contract extension and CRM access needed to restart campaigns are the immediate unlock; once those are confirmed, paid activity and a GBP recovery effort move forward together.
